personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, highly readable, and professionally structured utility that evokes the stability of modern finance applied to healthcare compliance.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS padding. lg or xl margins at screen roots. Cards must not flush to screen edges. Primary CTA sticky at bottom above safe area. 2-col grids use 'justifyContent: space-between' and wrap.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use on featured dashboard cards overlaid on the architectural hero background
dont's: Do not use on generic form fields or basic list items
Do not use if it breaks contrast (always layer a >70% opacity tint beneath foreground text on glass)

screens.name: AdminDashboard
screens.purpose: A commanding overview of agency compliance, showing total stats, audit readiness percentage, and actionable pending tasks.

states.error: Card displaying 'Unable to load stats' with retry button

screens.layout: Top portion features a hero image (abstract architecture) with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast. Displays an 'Audit Readiness' circular metric. Below the hero: a 2-column grid of modular stat cards (Total Clients, Pending Docs). Further down, an 'Action Required' list view. Bottom CTA floats over content or sits in tab bar.

screens.name: DocumentVault
screens.purpose: Securely organize and access folders for Clients, Caregivers, Onboarding, and Training materials.

states.empty: Image illustration of empty folders with text 'No folders found' and primary CTA 'Create Folder'

screens.layout: Standard iOS-native list view. Each row has 56pt height, a leading folder icon inside a brandTertiary tinted rounded square, the folder title, a document count subtitle, and a trailing chevron. Pinned top search/filter bar with a glass background.

screens.name: CaregiverOnboarding
screens.purpose: Track step-by-step required documents and training to achieve full compliance.
screens.layout: Top progress bar indicating completion percentage. Below, a checklist of 5-7 steps. Each row uses a clear visual state: outlined circle for pending, filled success color checkmark for complete. Generous padding between steps. Sticky primary CTA at bottom ('Submit Documents') if action is required.

screens.name: ComplianceAssistant
screens.purpose: Chat interface powered by Claude to query compliance status and audit requirements.

states.empty: Welcome message with suggested prompts in pill chips

screens.layout: Chat interface. Input field pinned to keyboard (KeyboardAvoidingView) with a surfaceTertiary background. Message bubbles use brandPrimary (user) and surfaceSecondary (AI). Safe area respected.

hero_dashboard.alt: Abstract clean architectural texture for dashboard hero

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality with a botanical 'Deep Moss Green' and 'Bone White' palette. Avoid any blue, navy, or purple as requested by strict global rules.
Ensure the AdminDashboard utilizes the 'hero_dashboard' image with a strict gradient scrim (transparent to >70% opacity) layered beneath the Audit Readiness score to guarantee WCAG text contrast.
For the DocumentVault list, default to using tinted icon containers (brandTertiary rounded squares) for the folder icons to provide a premium, finished look rather than bare icons.
In CaregiverOnboarding, apply a clear checklist UI layout. Progress tracking is vital for the product's job-to-be-done. Completed steps must visually stand out from pending ones.
Ensure all primary actions (like 'Submit Documents') use a sticky bottom CTA constrained by safe-area bounds, sitting above the scrolling content with a subtle glass or fade backdrop.
For avatars, use the caregiver_avatar URL as a primary representation of the user, falling back to initials if necessary, but avoid generic user placeholder icons.
Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the system UI.
